content.title: Jack Nicklaus' Masters 2026 honorary starters tee shot
content.text: PGAJack Nicklaus returns for honorary starters tee shot at 2026 Masters Lori SchmidtColumbus DispatchApril 9, 2026, 1:12 p.m. ETUnmute0:00/0:43Full screenKeep WatchingAmong the Masters' many traditions is the event teeing off with the traditional honorary starters ceremony.Upper Arlington's Jack Nicklaus, who earned the last of his six victories at the tournament 40 years ago, has been handling honorary starter's duties since 2010.MORE: Nicklaus' Masters win at age 40 stands the test of timeBut not many of his tee shots in that time have looked more like the swing of an ordinary duffer. On April 9, he sent the golf ball over the head of the gallery and into the trees. He warned bystanders beforehand to, "Watch out." After, he laughed and yelled a belated, "Fore!"Nicklaus, 86, was joined as an honorary starter by Gary Player (age 90) in 2012 and Watson (age 76) in 2022. Between the three golf greats, they have 11 Masters wins.Need a news break?
